rows.grounds: numeral specifying the quantity of thousands
locative plural indicating the domain or extent
compound denoting mechanisms or forms of birth; locative plural indicating location
past passive participle describing the condition of beings

items.question: What vast multitude of womb-mechanisms subjects beings to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
The domain consists of womb-diagrams or birth-mechanisms.
Beings within this domain are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
